checks.details: 9 KV candidates are grouped as 3 distinct territories with 3 candidates each.

Overview board and representative full-resolution candidates A1, B2, and C1 were visually inspected; all 9 candidates are visible on the overview with intact bottle silhouettes, readable copy, and unclipped layouts.
All 9 candidate KVs are RGB PNGs at 1122 x 1402 pixels; the selection overview is 1710 x 2440 pixels.

The locked product asset is byte-identical to the supplied product image. Both SHA-256 values are 5db0bf6ad57de7ea8f31030249ceb50387d2ff0d5f4d5564ee3a977b1e51b286. KVs place the complete source photo proportionally as a framed tile; ImageGen was not allowed to redraw the bottle or label.
The MORI wordmark silhouette was extracted from the supplied brand board and used consistently in each KV; no generated logo was used.

Every KV contains cream and terracotta. Pixel proximity checks found cream coverage from 18.4% to 65.7% and terracotta coverage from 3.3% to 18.0% across the nine candidates; exact source palette tokens are also defined in the render script.

Individual KV artwork renders only the supplied MORI logo plus the two approved phrases verbatim: 'Quiet hours, made tangible.' and '让夜晚慢下来。'. Candidate codes and territory labels exist only on the internal overview board.
Visual review found no beds, pills, clinical devices, treatment claims, insomnia-improvement claims, or efficacy symbols. ImageGen prompts explicitly excluded these cues.
No website hero, Instagram portrait, or email header was produced before KV selection.

unresolved_blockers.required_input: select one KV code from A1-A3, B1-B3, or C1-C3
